targets.authors: Wiener M, Hamilton R, Turkeltaub P, Matell MS, Coslett HB.
targets.title: Fast forward: rSMG stimulation alters time measurement.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Explicit comparison confirms the original rSMG temporal-prolongation effect. Added EEG analyses extend the finding. Authors do not frame any central finding as contrasting with the original.

reasoning: Nineteen newly tested volunteers received rTMS while judging duration. The article explicitly identifies its own earlier published rSMG experiment as the replicated work. CNV background studies motivate the extension rather than constitute explicitly selected targets.
